checkedAlternates.risk: Both truffles and morels are prized Ascomycota fungi.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Truffles fruit entirely underground (hypogeous, group-1), whereas morels produce above-ground honeycomb caps (group-2).
Shiitake has classic radiating gills beneath a cap (group-4), unlike gill-less wood ear, toothed lion’s mane, and pored maitake (group-3).
